# Multiple PD/PI Leadership Plan

<!-- REQUIRED whenever more than one PD/PI is designated — and only then.
     Delete this section for a single-PI application.
     Note: R35 MIRA and DP2 are single-PI mechanisms; this section does not
     apply to them. -->

## Rationale for Multiple PD/PIs

Why the science requires more than one PD/PI. The answer should be about
complementary expertise, not administrative convenience.

## Governance and Organizational Structure

Roles, responsibilities, and decision-making authority of each PD/PI, mapped
to specific Aims.

## Communication

Meeting cadence and how day-to-day coordination happens across sites.

## Conflict Resolution

The process for resolving scientific and administrative disagreements, and who
arbitrates if the PD/PIs cannot agree.

## Budget and Resource Allocation

How funds and personnel are distributed across PD/PIs and institutions.

## Intellectual Property

How IP and authorship are handled, if not covered by institutional policy.
